notes.bridge_ts_structure: 3670-line bridge.ts is well-organized with clear separation: helper management, window/app listing, screenshot capture, input events (click/drag/scroll/type), and tool execution wrappers. Uses executeTool pattern for consistent error handling and state tracking.
notes.swift_bridge_notes: 2097-line Swift bridge handles macOS accessibility API (AXUIElement), window management (CGWindow), and ScreenCaptureKit integration. AXRefStore pattern cleverly manages element references across RPC calls.
notes.permission_system: Two-tier permission model (Accessibility + Screen Recording) is correct for macOS. UI prompts are user-friendly; error messages guide users to System Settings with clear copy-to-clipboard feature for helper path.
notes.config_precedence: Config loading is well-designed: defaults → agent-dir → cwd/.pi → env-vars. Supports both snake_case and camelCase property names for flexibility.
notes.extension_tools: 15 tools defined covering: window discovery (list_apps, list_windows), capture (screenshot), input (click, double_click, drag, scroll, keypress, type_text, set_text), control (arrange_window, navigate_browser), and batching (computer_actions, wait).
notes.doctor_exit_code: pi-doctor reports exit code 1 due to unrelated issues (missing agent definitions: builder.md, reviewer.md, scout.md, planner.md, tester.md; broken symlinks in commands/). Computer-use package diagnostics are clean (Extensions: 64 files , Skills: 37 available ).
notes.dual_arch: Both arm64 and x64 macOS binaries are present, executable, and tracked in package.json 'files' field. Enables support for both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
